app.name: PlantCue
app.description: Plant-care reminders that live on your phone: add your plants, set how often they need water, fertiliser or misting, and get a local reminder. No account, no cloud, no paywall.
app.target_audience: People with 3 to 30 houseplants who want a dependable watering reminder without a subscription or an account, on Huawei phones and any Android device.
app.problem_solved: Houseplants die because people forget to water them or water them too often. The leading plant apps hide reminders behind trials, accounts and AI upsells; PlantCue is a plain, offline reminder that just works.

product_strategy.market_opportunity: Plant-care apps are a large, active category whose leaders monetise through aggressive trials and paywalls (PictureThis, Planta) or require accounts and network for AI features (Greg, Garden.gg). A no-account, offline, ad-supported reminder is the underserved middle, and Huawei devices without Google services are poorly served by the incumbents.
product_strategy.competitive_advantage: Works fully offline with local notifications, needs no account, has no paywall, runs on HMS devices, supports 9 languages, and keeps plant photos on the device. Honest scope: reminders and care history, no AI claims.
product_strategy.monetization_strategy: Free application supported by Huawei Petal Ads: banners on the plant list and stats screens, an interstitial at most once per session when opening stats. Never on add/edit/photo screens and never when the app is opened from a reminder notification.

technical.background_work: WorkManager (periodic daily check) + local notifications; no exact alarms in V1
technical.skeleton: Copy apps/receipt-lens; strip receipts/OCR/CSV; keep theme, navigation shell, Room setup, settings pattern, 9-language string structure and the real Petal Ads integration

features.name: Add plant
features.description: Create a plant with name, optional photo (system camera app or gallery picker; no CAMERA permission is declared, so none is requested), room/tag and notes.

features.name: Care schedules
features.description: Per plant: water every N days (required); fertilise every N weeks (optional); mist every N days (optional). Each schedule tracks last done and next due.

features.name: Today view
features.description: List of plants due today and overdue, grouped, with one-tap 'Done' per care type and a 'Snooze 1 day' action.

features.name: Daily reminder notification
features.description: One local notification per day at a user-chosen hour summarising what needs care; tapping opens Today. Notification actions: Done all, Snooze.

features.name: Plant list
features.description: All plants with photo thumbnail, room, next due date; filter by room; sort by next due or name; empty state.

features.name: Plant detail
features.description: Photo, schedules with next due, care history timeline, edit and delete actions, mark-done actions.

features.name: Care history
features.description: Every Done/Snooze is stored per plant with timestamp and care type.

features.name: Stats
features.description: Plants count, care events this month, on-time percentage, current streak of days with all due care done.

features.name: Edit and delete plant
features.description: Edit any field or schedule; deleting a plant removes its photo file, schedules and history.

features.name: Settings
features.description: Reminder hour, theme (light/dark/system), privacy information, ads information, battery-optimisation guidance for reliable reminders, about.

features.name: Petal Ads
features.description: Real Huawei Petal Ads SDK: banner on Plant list and Stats; interstitial on opening Stats at most once per session with the factory frequency policy.

features.name: Localization
features.description: All 9 factory languages with RTL support for Arabic; device language auto-detected.

features.name: Accessibility
features.description: Content descriptions, 48dp touch targets, font scaling, screen-reader compatible.

screens.name: Today
screens.purpose: Show what needs care now and let the user mark it done.
components: Empty state when nothing is due

screens.name: Plants
components: Plant cards with thumbnail and next due

screens.name: Add / Edit Plant
screens.purpose: Create or edit a plant and its schedules.

screens.name: Plant Detail
screens.purpose: Show one plant, its schedules and history.
components: Schedule cards with next due and Done button

requirements: Database operations off the main thread.
Room migrations for schema changes.
Deleting a plant deletes its photo file, schedules and events.
next_due_at is recomputed when a care action is marked done or snoozed.
No plant data leaves the device.
Exactly one daily summary notification at the configured hour, only when something is due or overdue.
Use WorkManager periodic work with flex window; do not request SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM in V1.
Request POST_NOTIFICATIONS in context (first time the user saves a plant), with an explanation screen, never at cold start.
Notification tap opens Today; ads are suppressed for that session start.
Settings must explain EMUI/battery-optimisation whitelisting with a button to the system settings page.

monetization.ad_frequency_rules: Banners only on Plants (S002) and Stats (S005). Interstitial only when opening Stats, at most once per app session, not in the first 60 seconds after launch, at least 3 minutes apart, at most one per 4 triggers. Never on Today, Add/Edit, Plant Detail, or the photo picker, and never in a session started from a notification tap. Ad unit IDs come from factory/apps.json via BuildConfig; Huawei test IDs in debug.

requirements: All visible strings in Android string resources; no hard-coded text.
Plurals for 'N plants', 'N days'.
Dates formatted per locale.
Arabic RTL verified on Today and Plant list.

design.style: Friendly, clean, Material 3, generous whitespace, photo-forward plant cards
requirements: Material 3
Large Done buttons on Today
Overdue state clearly distinct (colour + label, not colour alone)
No decorative animations
Accessible contrast
Font scaling supported
Plants, photos and history stay in app-private storage.
android:allowBackup=false so the 'stays on your device' claim is literally true.
The only network user is the Petal Ads SDK; the privacy policy discloses what it may collect (OAID, device/network info, ad interactions) and how to limit personalisation.
No account, no backend, no analytics, no crash reporting.
Deleting a plant removes its photo file.
privacy._collects_personal_data_note: Set to true on 2026-09-07: the Huawei Petal Ads SDK collects OAID, IP, device and app information, so AppGallery's privacy tags must say Yes. The app's own data stays on the device.

requirements: No plant identification or diagnosis claims anywhere in the app or store copy.
Every feature except ads works with no network.
First launch works offline.
Reminders fire without network.
Ad failures are silent and leave no empty space.

additional_tests: Unit: next_due_at computation for water/fertilise/mist after Done and after Snooze, including month boundaries.
Unit: on-time percentage and streak computation.
UI/screenshot: Today with overdue + due; Plants with 3 plants; Plant detail; Stats; Settings.
Manual: deny notifications, deny camera, airplane mode, RTL, large font, process death on Add/Edit.

requirements: Same signing keystore as ReceiptLens (factory RELEASE_* secrets).
versionCode increases every release.
No secrets in git.

distribution_regions: Set by the owner in the console before the first upload (same as ReceiptLens).
requirements: Real screenshots from the tested build only.
Store copy discloses ads and makes no AI claims.
App name availability ('PlantCue') verified when the app is created; fallbacks 'LeafCue', 'WaterWhen'.

icon.description: Leaf with a small clock/drop cue; green primary on a soft cream or deep green ground; 512x512 PNG rendered from the launcher vector.

screenshots.source: Real screenshots from the tested application build

requirements: No hard-coded ad unit IDs, keys or credentials.
App-private storage for photos.
No exported components beyond the launcher activity and the notification receiver/worker.
Do not declare the CAMERA permission; use ACTION_IMAGE_CAPTURE through the system camera app instead.
Photos downscaled to max 1280px on save.
Lazy lists for plants and history.
Daily worker completes in under 2 seconds.
Camera/gallery failures show a readable message and let the user continue without a photo.
Notification permission denied: app keeps working and Settings explains how to enable.
Ad failures never block the UI.
Database failures never silently lose data.

acceptance_criteria: Release APK and AAB build in Factory Build with the quality gate in --strict mode passing.
A plant can be created with a photo from the gallery and without a photo.
Marking water Done moves next_due_at by the configured interval; Snooze moves it by one day.
Today lists overdue and due plants and hides them once done.
A daily notification fires at the configured hour when something is due (verified with a device clock change or WorkManager test).
Deleting a plant removes its photo file from app storage.
Stats numbers match the care events in the database for a known fixture.
All strings exist in all 9 languages; Arabic renders RTL.
Banners appear only on Plants and Stats; no ad on Today, Add/Edit, Detail; interstitial never fires in a session started from a notification.
Airplane mode: every screen works, no empty ad boxes.
No Firebase, GMS, Google AI or reflection SDK stubs (quality gate).
